purpose: Original style blueprint; production sprites rebuilt from shared editable meshes, not cropped from the concept.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original art direction board for a modern warfare isometric RTS called Greyhaven. This is a design reference for rebuilding actual game sprite models, not a scene illustration. Eight labeled panels in a precise 4 columns by 2 rows grid. Each panel shows two otherwise identical units, cyan-blue faction on the left and red faction on the right, at the same 30 degree camera elevation and three-quarter isometric angle. Labels: 步枪兵, 反装甲兵, 工兵, 步兵战车, 主战坦克, 自行火炮, 工程车, 采矿车. Classic Red Alert 2 inspired compact, readable prerendered sprite aesthetic: chunky readable silhouettes and clear light/dark clusters, restrained pixel-like edges, only 3-4 shades per material, no gritty noise or tiny bolts, not photorealistic, not cute toy/chibi or Minecraft. Uniform warm light from upper left. Neutral muted olive and pale khaki metal, charcoal tyres/tracks. Large saturated faction-color panels occupying about 35-45 percent of visible upper unit surfaces, visible from front and back: cyan #259fce vs red #d84b41. Rifleman has helmet and strong colored torso holding a short dark rifle; AT infantry has broad shoulder-fired long dark launcher and broad colored torso; engineer yellow hardhat and tool satchel plus colored vest. IFV: sleek narrow eight-wheel high rear troop compartment, tiny short gun. Main battle tank: low broad twin tracks, large squat angular turret, clear long thick cannon and broad colored turret/skirt surfaces. Artillery: distinct very long barrel, tall rear-mounted box casemate on long narrow tracked chassis. Construction vehicle: large six-wheel truck with obvious folded yellow crane and pale utility box, large colored cab roof and side panels. Mining vehicle: compact six-wheel dump truck, very broad open gold ore bed and short colored cab; clearly different from crane truck. Separate each unit with breathing room. No existing franchise logos, no Soviet insignia, no UI screenshot, no photorealistic weathering. Dark charcoal plain panel backgrounds. Large previews with a small actual-size silhouette below each panel to demonstrate legibility. Attractive professional game-art approval board.
reference: Red Alert 2 visual language; user screenshot and community voxel silhouettes. No third-party game textures copied.
